# Quick Review



* First\, remember about language acquisition:
  * We  __acquire__  speech/sign
  * We must  __learn __ writing
* So\, what about CMC/emoji?
  * Characteristics?
  * Writing is learned\, but modern texting appears to be acquired
  * CMC is often very different from traditional modes of writing
* Texting seems to be about efficiency and meaning\-making
  * Examples?

---


# Emojis

![](images/Recitation%2010_1.png)



* Probably kind of pictograms/ideogram
* BUT they do seem to provide a bit of extralinguistic information\, like emotion\, sarcasm\, other message modulations
* Not a separate language
* Not ruining language
  * Same for other parts of CMC
  * These forms of communication differ stylistically from each other AND from traditional modes of communication\!

---


![](images/Recitation%2010_2.jpg)

# Quick Review



* __Computational linguistics__  is the area of linguistics that applies the methods of computer science to the analysis of language and speech
* Speech synthesis and speech recognition = not easy problems\!\!
  * Speech recognition = speech\-to\-text \(accuracy and speed\)
  * Speech synthesis = text\-to\-speech \(human\-like voices\)
* Why does it matter?

---


# Activity time!



* So\, since we’ve said that a lot of CMC is about  __meaning\-making__ \, we want to know how you interpret various emojis\!
* For each emoji \(next slide\)\, you need to do the following:
  * Answer this question: By itself\, what does it mean?
  * If you have differences in meaning between platforms \(e\.g\.\, text vs\. Snapchat\)\, explain those\.
  * Write out a text message you might send with this emoji\.
  * Explain how the addition of this emoji adds meaning beyond the text that is there\. Provide context\, as needed\.
  * Did we miss your fave? Tell us about it in the same way\!

---

You can either tell them to pick 5-6 individually to work on or divide them into groups to write and discuss. Just see if you can cover them all!
